note: Reasoning units emerged from boundary/diagnostic needs; count is not a target.

packages.name: Audience–Value Fit
packages.purpose: Represent who is being served, what value is hypothesized, and whether observed response is consistent with relevance without treating behavior as direct mind-state measurement.

units.name: Audience-state hypothesis
units.definition: A bounded, revisable representation of the target audience state, context, needs/goals and relevant heterogeneity.
warnings: Not a direct psychological measurement.
Demographic labels alone are insufficient.

units.name: Segment heterogeneity
units.definition: Material differences between audience groups that can change expected response, value, message fit, or distribution interpretation.
warnings: A mathematically separated cluster is not automatically a meaningful market/audience segment.

units.name: Value hypothesis
units.definition: A testable account-side proposition about what benefit, meaning, utility, identity relevance, entertainment, information, or other value an audience may perceive.
warnings: Value is audience- and context-relative.
Observed likes do not directly identify perceived value.

units.name: Relevance fit
units.definition: The degree to which a message/value proposition is applicable to a person's current goals, needs, social context, or interests, potentially changing processing and engagement.
warnings: Advertising evidence may not transport universally to organic creator content.
Relevance must remain distinct from actual attention or satisfaction.

units.name: Audience-composition shift
units.definition: A change in who receives or responds to content that can alter aggregate metrics without any underlying improvement or decline in the same individuals.
warnings: Before/after metric changes may be compositional rather than causal.

packages.name: Message / Creative Response
packages.purpose: Separate content response into distinct observable stages rather than collapsing all performance into engagement.

units.name: Appeal / selection
units.definition: Whether an exposed person chooses to begin consuming rather than ignore the content.
warnings: Selection is conditional on exposure and audience composition.
It does not directly measure latent attention.

units.name: Continuation
units.definition: Whether consumption continues after initial selection.
warnings: Continuation can reflect format, duration, intent, prior familiarity, and platform context.

units.name: Satisfaction
units.definition: Post-consumption positive evaluation inferred only through qualified direct/behavioral evidence, not from completion alone.
warnings: Completion is not satisfaction.
Engagement behavior is heterogeneous.

units.name: Expectation–delivery congruence
units.definition: Consistency between what packaging/framing promises and what the consumed content delivers.
warnings: Specific causal pathways require stronger claim-level evidence.

units.name: Content-effect contextuality
units.definition: The effect of content characteristics varies with sender, receiver, medium/platform, format and context; no single surface feature is universally optimal.
warnings: Do not convert review averages or platform advice into universal rules.

packages.name: Exposure vs Human Response
packages.purpose: Prevent recommendation-system opportunity from being confused with human psychological response.

units.name: Recommendation eligibility
units.definition: Whether content is allowed/qualified to participate in a recommendation or discovery surface under current platform rules.
warnings: Eligibility does not guarantee retrieval or exposure.
Rules are freshness-sensitive.

units.name: Retrieval / ranking opportunity
units.definition: Platform-side selection and ordering opportunity based on personalized predictions/signals.
warnings: Do not infer exact ranking weights unless officially disclosed and current.

units.name: Exposure opportunity
units.definition: A content impression/reach event creating the possibility of human processing.
warnings: Impression/reach is not attention, interest, trust, value or satisfaction.

units.name: Exposure–response separation
units.definition: Every diagnosis must distinguish platform opportunity from downstream human selection, continuation, satisfaction and action.
warnings: Low response can coexist with high distribution and vice versa.

units.name: Personalization feedback
units.definition: Observed interactions/history can become inputs to future content recommendations, changing subsequent exposure composition.
warnings: This creates endogeneity: future audiences are partly shaped by prior behavior and platform models.

packages.name: Trust / Relationship Accumulation
packages.purpose: Represent longitudinal account-level relationship hypotheses without duplicating HPC latent constructs.

units.name: Familiarity accumulation
units.definition: Repeated encounters can increase recognition/familiarity, potentially changing later evaluation or selection.
warnings: Repeated exposure alone does not establish trust or relationship quality.

units.name: Credibility accumulation
units.definition: Repeated source/message evidence may update audience judgments of expertise, trustworthiness or credibility.
warnings: Platform engagement is not a direct credibility measure.

units.name: Expectation consistency / violation
units.definition: Repeated consistency or mismatch between expected and delivered creator/content behavior may shape future relationship evaluations.
warnings: Requires construct-specific longitudinal evidence.

units.name: Parasocial relationship hypothesis
units.definition: A one-sided perceived social relationship with an online figure that has distinct antecedents, moderators and outcomes.
warnings: Repeated engagement or following does not prove PSR.
Validated instruments or strong multimethod evidence are preferred.

units.name: Relational outcome bundle
units.definition: Observable return, participation, loyalty and advocacy outcomes that may be consistent with multiple underlying relationship mechanisms.
warnings: Return is not habit; advocacy is not necessarily trust; loyalty requires longitudinal interpretation.

packages.name: Measurement / Experimental Learning
packages.purpose: Turn metrics into testable bounded learning rather than post-hoc stories.

units.name: Observation validity gate
units.definition: Classify an input as direct observation, validated construct measure, qualified proxy or ambiguous proxy before inference.
warnings: Ambiguous proxies cannot auto-seed latent states.

units.name: Competing explanation set
units.definition: For each material metric change, preserve plausible alternatives involving audience composition, distribution, content, context and relationship state.
warnings: A single plausible story is not diagnosis.

units.name: Intervention identifiability
units.definition: Determine whether an intervention actually isolates the changed variable sufficiently to support the intended inference.
warnings: Platform ad/A-B systems may change targeting/delivery, confounding creative effects.

units.name: Prediction + falsification record
units.definition: Before action, specify expected observable outcomes and what result would count against the hypothesis.
warnings: Avoid moving success criteria after results are observed.

units.name: Account-local belief update
units.definition: Update operational hypotheses from repeated account-specific evidence while keeping scientific evidence versioned separately.
warnings: One account outcome cannot promote a scientific mechanism to established.

units.name: Freshness / transport gate
units.definition: Check whether evidence and platform assumptions transport to the current platform, audience, format and time.
warnings: Platform mechanics and audience states are nonstationary.
